title: Markdown tables misaligned with characters outside the BMP
statement:
# Markdown table formatter (`src/mdtable.mjs`) The module generates and reads GFM-style Markdown tables, aligning the columns by **display width** (columns occupied in a monospaced terminal), not by the number of characters. Users report that some tables come out with the right border misaligned (one column of padding short) on rows that contain emoji. The module must fully obey the contract below; fix it without changing the API. ## Display width - `charWidth(cp)`: `cp` must be an integer in `[0, 0x10FFFF]`, otherwise `RangeError`. Returns: - **0** if `cp` is in one of these (inclusive) ranges: `U+0300–U+036F`, `U+1AB0–U+1AFF`, `U+1DC0–U+1DFF`, `U+200B–U+200F`, `U+20D0–U+20FF`, `U+FE00–U+FE0F`, `U+FE20–U+FE2F`; - **2** if it is in one of these (inclusive) ranges: `U+1100–U+115F`, `U+2E80–U+303E`, `U+3041–U+33FF`, `U+3400–U+4DBF`, `U+4E00–U+9FFF`, `U+A000–U+A4CF`, `U+AC00–U+D7A3`, `U+F900–U+FAFF`, `U+FE30–U+FE4F`, `U+FF00–U+FF60`, `U+FFE0–U+FFE6`, `U+1F300–U+1F64F`, `U+1F900–U+1F9FF`, `U+20000–U+3FFFD`; - **1** for any other code point. The lists above are exhaustive and take precedence over any external Unicode table. - `displayWidth(text)`: sum of `charWidth` over the **code points** of `text` (a UTF-16 surrogate pair is a single code point). Non-string → `TypeError`. - `displayWidth('漢字')` → `4`; `displayWidth('é')` → `1`; `displayWidth('😀')` → `2`; `displayWidth('𝐀')` (U+1D400) → `1`. ## Cells - `escapeCell(value)`: `null`/`undefined` → `''`; any other value → `String(value)`, and then, in this order: (1) each `\r\n`, `\r` or `\n` counts as **one** line break; (2) each tab becomes a space; (3) whitespace is removed from the ends (like `String.prototype.trim`, including line breaks); (4) each remaining line break becomes `
`; (5) each `|` becomes `\|`. Backslashes are not changed. - `escapeCell(' a|b\nc ')` → `'a\\|b
c'` (that is, `a\|b
c`); `escapeCell('x\r\ny')` → `'x
y'`; `escapeCell(0)` → `'0'`. - `unescapeCell(text)`: inverse: `\|` → `|` and `
` → `\n`. - `padCell(text, width, align = 'left')`: pads with spaces until `displayWidth` equals `width` (if it is already greater or equal, returns `text` intact). `'left'` and `'none'`: spaces on the right; `'right'`: on the left; `'center'`: `floor(extra/2)` spaces on the left and the rest on the right (the odd space goes on the **right**). - `padCell('ab', 5, 'center')` → `' ab '`; `padCell('ab', 5, 'right')` → `' ab'`. ## `normalizeRows(rows, { columns } = {})` → `{ header, body }` Non-array `rows` → `TypeError`; `columns`, if given, must be an array (otherwise `TypeError`). Values are returned **without** escaping; the input is never modified. - Empty `rows` → `{ header: copy of columns or [], body: [] }`. - **Array mode** (the first element is an array; if any other is not an array → `TypeError`): without `columns`, the first row is the header and the others are the body; with `columns`, the header is `columns` and **all** rows are body. The number of columns is the greatest length among the header and the body rows; missing positions (in the header or in the body) become `''`. - `normalizeRows([['a'], [1, 2, 3], [4]])` → `{ header: ['a', '', ''], body: [[1, 2, 3], [4, '', '']] }` - **Object mode** (the first element is not an array; all must be non-null, non-array objects, otherwise `TypeError`): header = `columns` or the union of the `Object.keys` keys of each row, in order of **first occurrence** (going through the rows in order). Cell = `row[key]` if the key is an **own** property of the row (`Object.hasOwn`), otherwise `''`. - `normalizeRows([{ b: 1, a: 2 }, { c: 3, a: 4 }])` → `{ header: ['b', 'a', 'c'], body: [[1, 2, ''], ['', 4, 3]] }` ## `formatTable(rows, { align = [], minWidth = 3, columns } = {})` → `string` - Validation (before anything else): non-array `align` → `TypeError`; any element of `align` that is not `null`, `undefined`, `'left'`, `'right'`, `'center'`, `'none'` or `'auto'` → `RangeError`; `minWidth` not an integer or `< 1` → `RangeError`. - Uses `normalizeRows(rows, { columns })`. No columns → `''`. The input (`rows`, `align`, `columns`) is never modified. All cells (header included) go through `escapeCell`, and widths are measured **on the escaped text**. - Alignment of column `j`: `align[j]`; missing/`null`/`undefined` → `'none'`. `'auto'` becomes `'right'` if the column has at least one non-empty **body** cell and all non-empty ones match `/^[-+]?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?$/`; otherwise it becomes `'left'` (the header does not count). - Column width = maximum among `minWidth`, the minimum marker width (`'none'` 1, `'left'`/`'right'` 2, `'center'` 3) and the `displayWidth` of all cells in the column (header included). - Separator of width `w`: `'none'` → `w` hyphens; `'left'` → `:` + `w-1` hyphens; `'right'` → `w-1` hyphens + `:`; `'center'` → `:` + `w-2` hyphens + `:`. - Each line (header, separator, body) is `'| ' + cells.join(' | ') + ' |'`, with header and body padded by `padCell` with the column's resolved alignment (`'none'` pads like `'left'`). Lines joined by `'\n'`, without a trailing `'\n'`. Example 1 — `formatTable([{ nome: 'Ana', idade: 31 }, { nome: 'Bo', cidade: 'Rio' }], { align: ['left', 'auto', 'center'] })`: ``` | nome | idade | cidade | | :--- | ----: | :----: | | Ana | 31 | | | Bo | | Rio | ``` Example 2 — `formatTable([['Fruta', 'Ícone'], ['maçã', '🍎']])`: ``` | Fruta | Ícone | | ----- | ----- | | maçã | 🍎 | ``` Example 3 — `formatTable([['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], [1, 2, 3, 4]], { minWidth: 1, align: ['left', 'right', 'center'] })`: ``` | a | b | c | d | | :- | -: | :-: | - | | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | ``` ## `parseTable(markdown)` → `{ header, align, rows }` - Non-string → `TypeError`. Splits into lines by `\r\n`, `\r` or `\n` and discards empty/whitespace-only lines. Fewer than 2 lines → `SyntaxError`. - Each line: `trim`; removes a leading `|`, if any, and a trailing `|`, if any and not preceded by `\`; splits on the `|` **not** preceded by `\`; each cell undergoes `trim` and then `unescapeCell` (except those of the separator). - The 2nd line is the separator: it must have the same number of cells as the header and each cell must match `/^:?-+:?$/`, otherwise `SyntaxError`. `align[j]`: `:` at both ends → `'center'`; only on the left → `'left'`; only on the right → `'right'`; none → `'none'`. - The following lines form `rows`, each one padded with `''` or truncated to the header's number of columns. - `parseTable('a | b\n:-: | --\nx \\| y | z | w\nq')` → `{ header: ['a', 'b'], align: ['center', 'none'], rows: [['x | y', 'z'], ['q', '']] }`

bugs.summary: displayWidth iterates over UTF-16 units with codePointAt(i): characters outside the BMP also add the width of the low surrogate (emoji = 3, U+1D400 = 2)
